title: Warm introductions through the owner's network
origin: ClimbOS synthesis (original proposal) from the member frameworks; author guidance is cited by finding id, proposed rules are labelled 'proposed'.
decision_task: Whether and how to ask people the owner knows for introductions to target accounts before cold outreach.
applies_when: No prospect database and no customers yet
exclusions: Owner unwilling to ask contacts personally
required_inputs: Owner's list of contacts (owner-held; not imported without consent)
evidence_requirements: a real relationship between the intermediary and the target, confirmed by the intermediary
missing_data_behavior: No network overlap: go to BKP-12.

decision_branches.then: Owner sends a short forwardable note; one ask per contact.

decision_branches.if: Friends or past colleagues show interest
decision_branches.then: Treat as unqualified until they pass the ICP.

implementation_steps: Owner exports or lists their own connections (no scraping of others' networks)
Optionally sit with an adviser who browses their own network
Ask intermediaries in one batched message
Send ready-to-forward notes (why them, why it helps the target, one ask)
Follow up once directly if forwarded
dependencies: account qualified before looking for a connection
guardrails: Use of exported connection data needs a lawful basis (unknown to investigate).
Mention the referrer only if they actually forwarded or agreed (skills/reply-handling/SKILL.md:48; skills/cold-outreach/reference/spam-and-ai-tells.md:16)
No scraping of LinkedIn networks; owner-provided data only
alternatives_when_constrained: No network: PB-partners or cold outreach
stop_conditions: Network exhausted (book: this runs out); move to cold or partners
review_triggers: Owner's numbers or business type change
A dated benchmark this playbook mentions is superseded
Selling to friends who don't fit
Claiming a referral that didn't happen

strategic_preference.rule: proposed: add playbook PB-warm-intros (requires: B2B types, owner_hours_min 2; no customer minimum), steps: qualify accounts, match connections, request a forwardable intro, one direct follow-up.

external_requirement.rule: proposed: an intro email may name the intermediary only when the owner confirms the intermediary agreed or forwarded.

unknown_to_investigate.rule: proposed: whether a user's own exported connection data can be processed for outreach under each platform's terms and GDPR needs legal review before it is automated.
